ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across the visible ventral surface, with high-intensity (white) disruptions localized to scar tissue and surface glints.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curves extending outward from the median notch, terminating in pointed distal tips.
